# DXXX — Decision title

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD  
**Status:** proposed / accepted / superseded

## Context

What scientific or implementation ambiguity required a decision?

## Decision

What exactly was decided?

## Rationale

Why is this choice preferable?

## Alternatives rejected

What other choices were considered and why were they rejected?

## Consequences

How does this affect interpretation, code, results or future data collection?

## Evidence

Dataset IDs, publications, diagnostics, tests or result files supporting the decision.
